steps.title: Assign sequencing identifier and label tubes
steps.instruction: Write down the SEQUENCING IDENTIFIER assigned to you (a number from 01 to 96) and label all tubes with this identifier.

steps.title: Gather tools, reagents, and ice
steps.instruction: Collect fine forceps, scissors, single‑sided razor blades, glass dishes, a permanent‑marker pen, gloves, labels, a tube rack, and an ice bucket or tray. In the ice bucket place 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes containing lysis buffer (clear liquid, labelled “LYS”) and PCR mix (clear liquid, labelled “PCR”), as well as the plastic strip tubes (four‑tube strips) with their lids.

steps.title: Wear gloves to protect samples
steps.instruction: Put on gloves to prevent contamination of the DNA samples with your own DNA.

steps.title: Prepare and label strip tubes
steps.instruction: Using a permanent marker, label tube 1 of each strip as “LYS”, tube 2 as “PCR”, and label the remaining tubes with your sequencing barcode. Write each label in at least two places on the tube so the label does not wear off.

steps.title: Retrieve specimens and keep on ice
steps.instruction: Take the DNA barcoding bag from the back of the lab; it contains four specimens. Keep the specimens on ice at all times and work quickly because DNA begins to degrade once thawed.

steps.title: Collect and crush tissue samples
steps.instruction: For each specimen, open its container, cut off a ~3 mm piece of tissue with scissors or a razor blade, and place the piece into tube 1 of the extraction strip tube. Use a yellow pipette tip to crush the tissue so it settles at the bottom. Repeat for all four specimens, combining all tissue pieces into the same tube; the other three tubes remain empty. Keep the strip tube on ice in the rack.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and seal tubes
steps.instruction: Pipette 25 µl of LYS buffer into the tube that now contains the combined tissue pieces. Firmly replace the strip lids on the extraction strip tubes.

steps.title: Run lysis program in PCR machine
steps.instruction: Place the sealed extraction strip tube into a PCR machine, ensuring the tube is clearly labelled with your SEQUENCING IDENTIFIER and noting which machine you are using. Start the lysis incubation: heat to 95 °C, then incubate at 65 °C through a couple of cycles; the entire process takes about 25 minutes.

steps.title: Proceed to PCR next day
steps.instruction: After the 25‑minute lysis, remove the tube and store it as instructed; the sample is now ready for the PCR step on Day 2.
